// Main POV file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

global_settings {
  assumed_gamma 1.0
  max_trace_level 15
}

== 00001.inc
#declare use_focal_blur = 0; // 0=off 1=low quality 10=high quality

// Include file generated by Bullet Physics Playground

box { <-1, -0.25, -0.5>, <1, 0.25, 0.5>
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <0.266667, 0.266667, 0.266667, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,5,0>
}

camera {
  location < 10, 7, -12 >
  right image_width/image_height*x
  look_at <-534512, -267254, 801772>   angle degrees(2*atan(tan(radians(45)/2)*image_width/image_height))
  sky <-0.14825, 0.963624, 0.222375>
#if(use_focal_blur)
  aperture 5
  blur_samples 10*use_focal_blur
  focal_point <0, 0, 0>   confidence 0.9+(use_focal_blur*0.0085)
  variance 1/(2000*use_focal_blur)
#end
}

cylinder { -0.3*z, 0.3*z, 1.2
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <0.266667, 0.533333, 1, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          3,3.5,0>
}

plane { <0, 1, 0>, 0
  texture {
    pigment { rgbt <0.133333, 0.133333, 0.133333, 0> }
  }
  matrix <1,0,0,
          0,1,0,
          0,0,1,
          0,0,0>
}
